question: Which is the only living representative of Sphenopsida that has an underground, creeping and perennial rhizome that gives off aerial as well as underground branches?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Equisetum.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is** option 4, Equisetum**, which is commonly known as** horsetail or scouring rush.**
 
• Equisetum has an **underground, creeping and perennial rhizome** that gives off **aerial **as well as** underground branches**.
 
• It is the only living representative of **Sphenopsida**, a group of **vascular plants **that were dominant during the **Carboniferous period.**
 
• **Adiantum**, also known as** maidenhair fern,** belongs to the group of **ferns **and **does no**t have an underground rhizome.
 
 
• It has **delicate fronds** and is commonly grown as an** ornamental plant.**
 
 
 
• **Dryopteris** is another **group of ferns** that **does not** have an underground rhizome.
 
 
• It is commonly known as **wood fern **and is also grown as an **ornamental plant.**
 
 
 
• **Selaginella, **also known as **spike moss,** is a group of plants that are **similar to ferns** but have** smaller leaves** and are adapted to grow in** dry environments.**
 
 
• They **do not** have an underground rhizome.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0f43c31587a372f5a7ce0db582a061e8322aa1ad07f7bc85d4b2c70866286b5.png] 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Equisetum** is a **unique plant** that has been used for** medicinal purposes **for centuries.

 
 
• It contains **silica **and other minerals that are believed to have **anti-inflammatory and diuretic properties.**
 
 
 
• **Adiantum** is also used in **traditional medicine** to treat **respiratory and digestive problems.**
 
 
• It is also used in **hair care products** because of its **high silica content.**
 
 
 
• **Dryopteris **is commonly used in landscaping because of its** attractive foliage **and** tolerance to shade.**
 
• **Selaginella** is used in** terrariums and indoor gardens** because of its **small size and unique appearance.**
